1. Executive Summary & Design Goals

The Cross-App Responsive Dashboard is an adaptive workstation dashboard designed to manage repositories, track telemetry metrics, and review active sprints. Built entirely using standard Flutter widgets with zero external package dependencies, it enforces strict architectural simplicity through a clean 2-screen pattern:

  • DashboardScreen: The primary multi-section hub presenting KPI statistics, category filters, a repository grid, and timeline activity.
  • ProjectDetailScreen: A lightweight detail view navigated via standard Flutter routing with an AppBar pop back button.

2. Technical Architecture & Breakpoint Matrix

The interface continuously queries MediaQuery.of(context).size to dynamically adjust column counts, aspect ratios, and drawer visibility across three standard device tiers:

Tier Screen Width Layout Pattern Sidebar Mode Grid Columns
Desktop ≥ 1024 px 3-Pane Row (Sidebar + Feed + Right Panel) Expanded (230px+) 4 KPI / 3 Project
Tablet 600 – 1023 px 2-Pane Row (Rail + Consolidated Feed) Compact Rail (Icon-Only) 2 KPI / 2 Project
Mobile < 600 px Single-Column ScrollView Slide-Out Modal Drawer 2 KPI / 1 Project
Core Concepts Demonstrated: Flexible & Expanded proportional allocation (flex: 2, 7, 3), dynamic grid aspect ratios via MediaQuery, horizontal and vertical ListView builders, and Material 3 theme typography.

3. Component Structure & Data Flow

All business entities and UI widgets are cleanly partitioned into isolated, reusable classes:

Component File Responsibility & Key Flutter Widgets
dashboard_screen.dart Main responsive orchestrator managing search query state, category filter, and bookmark IDs.
project_detail_screen.dart Detail subpage with Navigator.pop(), linear progress bar, metadata stats, and action buttons.
kpi_metrics_grid.dart Telemetry grid utilizing GridView.builder with dynamic crossAxisCount based on viewport.
category_filter_bar.dart Horizontal scroll selector using ListView.separated with animated selection pills.
project_catalog_grid.dart Responsive repository grid with bookmark toggle actions and tap routing to detail screen.
activity_stream_list.dart Vertical timeline feed utilizing ListView.separated with avatar badges and timestamps.
sidebar_navigation.dart Multi-mode navigation component supporting full sidebar, compact rail, and drawer modes.

7. Project Detail Subpage & Back Navigation

Tapping any project card in the grid pushes the clean, focused ProjectDetailScreen via standard Flutter routing.

Figure 3.1: Project Detail View (PRJ-01). Displays standard AppBar back arrow (Navigator.pop), category badge, project overview narrative, sprint progress indicator (85%), due date and contributor statistics, and interactive bookmark toggle button.

8. Architectural Evaluation & Summary

By consolidating what was previously 6 bloated pages into a clean, well-tested 2-screen architecture, the application achieves instantaneous compile times, zero layout overflow errors, and an intuitive user experience. The full suite of responsive layout widgets (MediaQuery, ListView, GridView, Flexible, Expanded) provides a benchmark implementation for cross-platform Flutter engineering.
